name: discover-accounts-fintech-icp
description: Fintech ICP should return real fintech/adjacent companies, not generic SaaS names.

businessContext.overview: Real-time fraud + KYC infrastructure for fintechs.

icp.title: Head of Trust & Safety at scaling fintechs
icp.description: Growth-stage fintechs handling >$500M/year in transactions who face rising fraud losses.
buyingSignals: Recent fraud incident or public breach
New market expansion (US to EU or LATAM)

expectations.rubric: The returned accounts must be plausibly real fintech / payments / neobank companies (e.g. Chime, Wise, Nubank, Revolut, Mercury, Ramp, Brex etc.). Score high if 4+ recognizable real names appear. Score low if the list is dominated by generic SaaS companies (Salesforce, HubSpot) or clearly invented names.
